guideContent.strategyOverview: This upgrade transforms Endless Punishment from a casual Bracket 1-2 precon into a focused Bracket 3 group slug powerhouse. We're removing underperformers and slow lands while adding damage multipliers, a late-game infinite combo, and a premium mana base. The Lord of Pain rewards you for dealing damage to opponents with card draw and life drain, making damage multiplication effects extremely powerful.

full.name: Pain Amplified
